verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents issue tracking with labels and milestones, which gives basic task organization and some milestone-level grouping. Nothing in the evidence mentions project boards, kanban views or roadmap planning, so the story as written is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: project boards (kanban/table views), roadmap or timeline views, linking high-level initiatives to everyday tasks on a board, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
